sub_locations.name: Mandorcai's Mansion
sub_locations.description: A mysterious manor in the [[Bloomridge]] neighborhood, believed to have been built by its namesake – [[tiefling]] [[wizard]] [[Mandorcai]], in reality, its origin was much more [[fiend]]ish in nature.

sub_locations.name: Seskergates
sub_locations.description: A tower of a manse of the [[Sesker]] mercantile clan, purchased by the eccentric Baldurian court-[[mage]] named [[Imbralym Skoond]] in the 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

sub_locations.name: Bormul House
sub_locations.description: The elegant three-story townhouse of yellow [[granite]], home to the Baldurian branch of the [[Amn]]ian [[Bormul Dynasty]].

sub_locations.name: Hhune House
sub_locations.description: The palatial manse home of the influential [[patriar]] [[Hhune]] family, relatives of the royal house of [[Tethyr]].

sub_locations.name: Eomane House
sub_locations.description: The estate home of the [[Eomane]] family that controlled the most elite [[perfume]]ry in the city as well as [[fish]] and lamp [[fish oil]] processing factories.

sub_locations.name: Rillyn House
sub_locations.description: The house of the [[Rillyn]] [[patriar]] family of '''[[Baldur's Gate]]''', built on wealth gained through adventuring.

sub_locations.name: Vanthampur Villa
sub_locations.description: Home to the wealthy [[patriar]] noble [[Vanthampur]] family in [[Baldur's Gate]].

sub_locations.name: Ramazith's Tower
sub_locations.description: The landmark tower built by renowned [[sage]] and zoologist, [[Ramazith Flamesinger]], sometime before [[1368 DR]]; it was purchased by the [[Athkatlan]] [[mage]] [[Lorroakan]] in  [[1492 DR]].

sub_locations.name: Whitkeep Hostel
sub_locations.description: A large manor that served a number of purposes throughout its existence; during the later 15{{th}} century [[DR]], a [[gnome|gnomish]] artists' commune resided within.

sub_locations.name: Silvershield Estate
sub_locations.description: The family home of the [[Silvershield]] [[patriar]] family of [[Baldur's Gate]] – a massive grand complex nearly the size of an entire city block that offered little comfort and coziness to its inhabitants and visitors.

sub_locations.name: Omduil's Manor
sub_locations.description: Home to [[Omduil]], sage and seer for hire in the 14{{th}} century [[DR]].

sub_locations.name: Jhasso Estate
sub_locations.description: The home of the [[Jhasso]] [[patria]]r family of [[Baldur's Gate]], part-owners of the [[Seven Suns Trading Coster]].

sub_locations.name: Coran's Manor
sub_locations.description: Home to the wealthy adventurer-turned-politician named [[Coran]], until his death in [[1492 DR]].

sub_locations.name: Hullhollyn Estate
sub_locations.description: The family manse of a prominent [[patriar]] family – House [[Hullhollyn]], that ran a sizable merchant fleet.

sub_locations.name: Sashenstar Estate
sub_locations.description: The home to the wealthy [[Sashenstar]] [[patriar]] family, members of the [[Merchant's League]], who owned shipping, mining, and textile operations.

sub_locations.name: Shattershield Estate
sub_locations.description: The home to the only non-[[human]] [[patriar]] family – [[Shattershield]], that was instrumental in building the city's [[Old Walls (Baldur's Gate)|Old Walls]].

sub_locations.name: Vannath Estate
sub_locations.description: The manse that belongs to the [[Vannath]] [[patriar]] family that fled to [[Baldur's Gate]] from [[Neverwinter]] after the [[Spellplague]].

sub_locations.name: Oberon Estate
sub_locations.description: The home of the [[Oberon (family)|Oberon]] [[patriar]] family of [[Baldur's Gate]] that owned the majority of the city's dry docks.

sub_locations.name: Belt Estate
sub_locations.description: The manse of the [[Belt (family)|Belt]] [[patriar]] family that built its wealth via the business holdings related to the sale and exchange of horses.

sub_locations.name: Eltan Estate
sub_locations.description: The home of the [[Eltan]] [[patriar]] family that was connected to the founding of the [[Flaming Fist]].

sub_locations.name: Ravenshade Estate
sub_locations.description: The home of the [[Ravenshade]] [[patriar]] family that dealt in [[ink]]s, [[dye]]s, [[gem]]s, and jewelry.

sub_locations.name: Caldwell Estate
sub_locations.description: Home of the [[Caldwell]] clan – one of the oldest and richest [[patriar]] families of [[Baldur's Gate]].

sub_locations.name: Gist Estate
sub_locations.description: The estate of the [[Gist]] [[patriar]] family.

sub_locations.name: Vammas Estate
sub_locations.description: The home of the [[Vammas]] [[patriar]] family.

sub_locations.name: Redlocks Estate
sub_locations.description: The [[Redlocks]] [[patriar]] family manse, the clan that was rumored to have had an affiliation with piracy.

sub_locations.name: Nurthammas Estate
sub_locations.description: The Estate of the [[Nurthammas]] [[patriar]] family that dealt in supplying ships for long voyages.

sub_locations.name: Whitburn Estate
sub_locations.description: The home of the [[Whitburn]] [[patriar]] family that owned a [[slate]] quarry.

sub_locations.name: Provoss Estate
sub_locations.description: The estate of the [[Provoss]] [[patriar]] family that faced hardships after dire cattle herd losses in the 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

sub_locations.name: Portyr Estate
sub_locations.description: The estate of a ruling Ducal [[Portyr]] family of [[Baldur's Gate]] in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

sub_locations.name: Stelmane Estate
sub_locations.description: The estate of a ruling Ducal [[Stelmane]] family of [[Baldur's Gate]] in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

sub_locations.name: Linnacker Estate
sub_locations.description: The home manse of the [[Linnacker]]  [[patriar]] that made wealth from [[gem]] mines in [[Tethyr]].

sub_locations.name: Jannath Estate
sub_locations.description: The estate of the [[Jannath]] [[patriar]] family that owned profitable [[copper]] mines.

sub_locations.name: Miyar Estate
sub_locations.description: Home to a family member of the [[Merchant’s League]] – the [[Miyar]] [[patriar]] family that controlled the caravan supply and repair businesses.

sub_locations.name: Oathoon Estate
sub_locations.description: The manse of the [[Oathoon]] [[patriar]] family that traded in [[wine]]s and spirits.

sub_locations.name: Hlath Estate
sub_locations.description: The home estate of the influential [[Hlath (family)|Hlath]] [[patriar]] family.

sub_locations.name: Tillerturn Estate
sub_locations.description: The home of the [[Tillerturn]] [[patria]]r family of [[Baldur's Gate]] that owned the lion's share of the city's buildings.

sub_locations.name: Dlusker Estate
sub_locations.description: The home of the [[Dlusker]] textile [[patriar]] family, down on its luck in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

sub_locations.name: Guthmere Estate
sub_locations.description: The family estate of the [[Guthmere]] [[patriar]] family that owned many butcheries and tanneries.

sub_locations.name: Home of Krammoch Arkhstaff
sub_locations.description: The office and home of [[sage]] and retired adventurer Krammoch Arkhstaff in the late 14{{th}} century [[DR]].

sub_locations.name: Home of Ragefast
sub_locations.description: The office and home of the well-respected sage named [[Ragefast]] in the late 14th century [[DR]].

sub_locations.name: Highberry Home
sub_locations.description: The manse home of [[Cora Highberry]] and [[Roger Highberry]] ''circa'' [[1492 DR]], and the site of their lavish [[wine]] festivals.{{approx}}

sub_locations.name: Fauragates
sub_locations.description: The mansion home of the reclusive moneylender Lord [[Erevvus Qwulthurr]] and his consort, magical [[tattoo]]ist, [[Valanthia Harvonth]] in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]].
